_comment: Canonical emergent-theme taxonomy. IMPORTANT: this is NOT the old 4 fixed policy topics. Two-layer design — (1) ENTITY frequency is PURELY emergent, no predefinition, the raw 'what is Illinois focused on' signal; (2) THEMES are a normalized overlay so surge trends stay comparable week to week instead of fragmenting (the same story labeled five ways kills a baseline). analyze.py maps each article's free-text model theme to a canonical theme via the aliases below; any theme it can't map is PROPOSED to themes_pending.json for human review and never auto-added. The set is deliberately broad/neutral coverage areas and grows by human-gated discovery — it is a frozen-then-extended taxonomy, not a prejudged bucket list. Edit deliberately: changing canonical themes changes historical comparability.
